contract.field_construction: CPU in memory or synchronized GPU archive for each changed position
contract.observer: Host FP64 curved eclipse, identical for both field backends
contract.physical_baseline: 28 synthetic band observations generated with the original 12-degree ELISa facet model at 1e-4 uncertainty
contract.scope: Circular detached binary with two reflection sweeps, blackbody spectra and fixed linear limb-darkening coefficients
contract.seed_selection: First eight in m041 directory order, specified before the new draws
contract.timing: One fresh run per backend per generation, from checkpoint validation and initialization through durable sampler results and host-unit exit. Includes all GPU window setup, compilation, synchronization and archive transfer. Excludes one-time snapshot export and the subsequent cross-backend audit.
contract.timing_context: One short regression run used two cores of the first CPU configuration. Later regression checks used separate cores.
contract.unit_schedule: Separate configurations. CPU before GPU in round 1, reversed in round 2.

science.finite_check: Every in-prior draw evaluated two fields, emitter groupings, eclipse depths and interior rules
science.scope: Observed displacement per transition across the supplied generations; these short traces do not estimate posterior uncertainty or effective samples.
